title: QuoteCheck Input
description: Compare supplier quotes from PDFs or structured JSON and return machine-readable price, quantity, and exception data.

quote_stores.title: Supplier quote file stores
quote_stores.description: Select one or more Apify Key-Value Stores containing text-based supplier quote PDFs. QuoteCheck reads PDF records from the selected stores. Scanned PDFs requiring OCR are not supported in this MVP.

quotes.title: Structured supplier quotes
quotes.description: Optional JSON input for API and agent workflows. Use this instead of quote storage.
